title: Qt: Export the entire flow graph as image (or as much as we can)
description:
Add a preference for the maximum number of items (frames) to print.
Export an image containing as much of the graph as possible, with
all the nodes and as many items as possible.

Export the entire graph if we can. If the entire graph doesn't fit,
export the number of items in the preference; either starting with
the current item (if there are more than that many items left)
or from the end.

Fix #13504
